import os,sys,subprocess,json,hashlib,platform
from pathlib import Path
S=Path(r"C:\Users\manem\Desktop\QASCP\public-review-20261125")
O=Path(r"C:\Users\manem\AppData\Local\Temp\qascp-re-audit-20261126-5919d022")
env=dict(os.environ,TEMP=str(O),TMP=str(O),PYTHONDONTWRITEBYTECODE="1")
runs=[]
for label,args in [
 ("foundation",["scripts/verify_foundation.py"]),
 ("lock",["scripts/verify_validation_lock.py"]),
 ("checkout-tests",["-m","unittest","discover","-s","tests","-p","test_checkout_auth.py","-v"]),
 ("lock-tests",["-m","unittest","discover","-s","tests","-p","test_validation_lock.py","-v"]),
 ("openapi",["scripts/verify_openapi_contracts.py"]),
 ("full-unittest",["-m","unittest","discover","-s","tests","-v"])]:
 cmd=[sys.executable,"-B",*args]
 r=subprocess.run(cmd,cwd=S,env=env,capture_output=True,text=True,encoding="utf-8",errors="replace")
 file=O/("04-local-"+label+".txt");file.write_text(r.stdout+r.stderr,encoding="utf-8")
 runs.append(dict(label=label,command=cmd,exit_code=r.returncode,output_file=file.name,sha256=hashlib.sha256(file.read_bytes()).hexdigest()))
print(json.dumps(dict(environment=dict(python=sys.version,platform=platform.platform()),runs=runs),indent=2))
(O/"04-local-results.json").write_text(json.dumps(runs,indent=2),encoding="utf-8")
